purpose: Phase 4 ships the full RAG architecture against this curated 7-machine subset; corpus expansion is Phase 4.5 work. The slate spans every in-scope manufacturer scraper so the showcase demonstrates retrieval breadth (not just Stern) on day one. Verified by tools/phase4/VerifyCuratedSubsetCoverage.csx.

specReferences.exitCriterion: Each machine has ≥1 manual PDF in deployed scraped_documents; Stern machines (Godzilla + Foo Fighters) additionally have ≥1 service bulletin.
specReferences.phase45: Phase 4.5 corpus expansion removes the curated-subset filter and extends bulletin ingestion to non-Stern manufacturers.

documentTypes._casingNote: Manifest uses PascalCase to match the source-side `PinballWizard.Core.Models.DocumentType` enum and the Phase 1 file-system catalog's `classification.document_type` values (`Manual`, `ServiceBulletin`). ADR-0021's AI Search index field is lowercase snake_case (`manual`, `service_bulletin`, `metadata_card`); that translation happens at indexing time, downstream of this manifest.
documentTypes.Manual: Owner / operator / repair manual PDF — primary source for rules, mode descriptions, parts lists, and wiring diagrams.
documentTypes.ServiceBulletin: Stern's per-issue advisory PDFs (SB-####). Repair sub-agent quality at launch hinges on bulletin grounding for the curated Stern slate.

machines.title: Godzilla
machines.rationale: The marquee Stern title for the showcase — deep mode rules, broad public familiarity, rich service-bulletin history. Godzilla Premium also drives the Phase 3 H2 OPDB-disambiguation hardening fixture (Stern 2021 vs. Sega 1998).

machines.title: Foo Fighters
machines.rationale: Recent Stern release — confirms the slate spans both established (Godzilla) and current production titles. LE edition exercises the alias-edition path through Cosmos.

machines.title: Toy Story 4
machines.rationale: JJP's 2024 release — covers the WP-REST + JSON-LD scraper path. JJP doesn't publish service bulletins on the manufacturer site, so the slate's bulletin coverage is Stern-only by design.

machines.title: Galactic Tank Force
machines.rationale: American Pinball's flagship recent title — covers the DOM-heuristic scraper path.

machines.title: Halloween
machines.rationale: Spooky's 2024 horror-themed flagship — covers the boutique-manufacturer scraper path. Spooky's outline-poor manuals exercise the chunker's no-outline fallback (ADR-0019).

machines.title: Attack from Mars
machines.rationale: CGC's flagship remake — covers the custom-Nginx scraper path. CGC remake docs frequently lack rich PDF outlines, exercising the chunker's no-outline fallback alongside Spooky.

machines.title: Queen
machines.rationale: Pinball Brothers' Queen LE — covers the WP-REST + slug-filter scraper path. Rounds out the seven-machine slate at one machine per in-scope manufacturer beyond Stern's two.
